title: Qwen (qwen/spec/**/*.json)
description: One prompt per JSON file under qwen/spec/, including subfolders. The path relative to qwen/spec/ without .json is the spec id. ComfyUI filename_prefix is that id (nested folders preserved). Natural-language prompt for Qwen-Image-2512; not Animagine tag arrays.

prompt.description: Positive prompt sent to ComfyUI as-is. Prose, not tag arrays. example.json is a fill-in template; brace placeholders are not expanded, so replace them (or omit unused slots) before generating. Recommended order: subject, pose, setting, style, camera, lighting, atmosphere. Optional quality phrases (e.g. Ultra HD, 4K, cinematic composition) go at the end.

negative.description: Optional negative prompt. Natural language. The Qwen-Image-2512 official default is in example.json. Omit when unused; ComfyUI then receives a single space. Has little effect when CFG is 1.
